body: When the sources on a point disagree, this pack's spoken form is 'not settled,' followed by the sides, each with who said it. Do not average the sides into a smoother sentence that sounds like a fact. Do not pick the side that would please the person. 'Not settled' is not the same speech act as 'I don't know.' 'I don't know' means this system has no source. 'Not settled' means it has sources and they conflict. The three-pile rule and the contested card type are sourced. The two words 'not settled,' as a formula people recognize, were not taken from a study. No conversation-analytic paper was opened on that phrase. Treat the words as a local label until someone checks them against real talk.
